pieces.name: security_camera
pieces.note: pivot on the floor under the swivel; child 'security_camera_head' swivels about Y at y=2.45, lens looks +X (east) at rotation 0 (= Tiled yaw 0); 'security_camera_led' is RJ_Ok, set it to RJ_Danger when it sees you

pieces.name: keypad
pieces.note: number pad; pivot = centre of the wall cell it hangs on, panel on the -Y (south) face at 1.25 m; child 'keypad_led' starts RJ_Ok (swap to RJ_Danger on a wrong code)

pieces.name: card_reader
pieces.note: keycard slot (bank); pivot = centre of the wall cell it hangs on, panel on the -Y (south) face at 1.25 m; child 'card_reader_led' starts RJ_Ok (swap to RJ_Danger on a wrong code)

pieces.name: safe
pieces.note: back-room safe, door faces south; child 'safe_door' hinges at the front-left corner (rotate about Y, negative = open outward to the left); 'safe_loot' hides once bagged

pieces.name: bag_light
pieces.note: duffel, long axis X, pivot on the floor under its centre; jewelry: 90% speed, sprint ok, throw 6 m

pieces.name: bag_medium
pieces.note: duffel, long axis X, pivot on the floor under its centre; cash: 75% speed, no sprint, throw 4 m

pieces.name: bag_heavy
pieces.note: duffel, long axis X, pivot on the floor under its centre; gold / paintings: 60% speed, throw 3 m

pieces.name: van
pieces.note: Dot's van: nose north (-Z), rear doors south (+Z) toward the drop zone; children 'van_door_l'/'van_door_r' hinge at the rear corners (rotate about Y); fits the 4 x 4 Tiled rect lengthwise with room to spare

pieces.name: desk_office
pieces.note: owner's desk, 3 x 1 cells (matches Tiled 'desk'); front = customer side (south), chair side north

pieces.name: security_desk
pieces.note: security monitors, 2 x 1 cells; guard sits on the north side facing the screens; the screens (RJ_Screen) face north

pieces.name: office_chair
pieces.note: faces south (-Y blender / +Z glTF); swivel freely

pieces.name: lamp_ceiling
pieces.note: hanging pendant, pivot on the floor under it, shade bottom at 2.25 m; RJ_Sodium is emissive

pieces.name: sticky_note
pieces.note: the safe code: an 8 cm note lying flat at y=0.002; lift it onto a desk/counter top in code (set position.y to the surface height)
